import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem anticommutator_commutes_with_int_polynomial {R : Type*} [Ring R] (a x : R) (h : a ^ 2 = 0) (p : Polynomial ℤ) :
  (a * x + x * a) * p.sum (fun n c => (c : R) * a ^ n) =
    p.sum (fun n c => (c : R) * a ^ n) * (a * x + x * a) := by
  let c : R := a * x + x * a
  
  have h_mul_sq : a * a = 0 := by
    simpa [pow_two] using h
  
  have h_base : a * c = c * a := by
    dsimp [c]
    calc
      a * (a * x + x * a) = (a * a) * x + (a * x) * a := by
        rw [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
      _ = (a * x) * a + x * (a * a) := by
        simp [h_mul_sq]
      _ = (a * x + x * a) * a := by
        rw [add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
  
  have h_power : ∀ k : ℕ, c * a ^ k = a ^ k * c := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        simp
    | succ k ih =>
        calc
          c * a ^ (Nat.succ k) = c * (a ^ k * a) := by
            rw [pow_succ]
          _ = (c * a ^ k) * a := by
            rw [mul_assoc]
          _ = (a ^ k * c) * a := by
            rw [ih]
          _ = a ^ k * (c * a) := by
            rw [mul_assoc]
          _ = a ^ k * (a * c) := by
            rw [h_base]
          _ = (a ^ k * a) * c := by
            rw [← mul_assoc]
          _ = a ^ (Nat.succ k) * c := by
            rw [pow_succ]
  
  have h_nat_coeff : ∀ n : ℕ, c * (n : R) = (n : R) * c := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        simp
    | succ n ih =>
        simp [Nat.cast_succ, add_mul, mul_add, ih]
  
  have h_signed : ∀ z : ℤ, ∃ m n : ℕ, z = (m : ℤ) - n := by
    intro z
    cases z with
    | ofNat n =>
        exact ⟨n, 0, by simp⟩
    | negSucc n =>
        exact ⟨0, n + 1, by omega⟩
  
  have h_int_coeff : ∀ z : ℤ, c * (z : R) = (z : R) * c := by
    intro z
    rcases h_signed z with ⟨m, n, rfl⟩
    calc
      c * (((m : ℤ) - n : ℤ) : R) =
          c * ((m : R) - (n : R)) := by norm_num
      _ = c * (m : R) - c * (n : R) := by rw [mul_sub]
      _ = (m : R) * c - (n : R) * c := by
        rw [h_nat_coeff m, h_nat_coeff n]
      _ = ((m : R) - (n : R)) * c := by rw [sub_mul]
      _ = (((m : ℤ) - n : ℤ) : R) * c := by norm_num
  
  have h_coeff :
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        c * ((p.coeff n : R) * a ^ n) =
          (p.coeff n : R) * a ^ n * c := by
    intro n
    calc
      c * ((p.coeff n : R) * a ^ n) =
          (c * (p.coeff n : R)) * a ^ n := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = ((p.coeff n : R) * c) * a ^ n := by
        rw [h_int_coeff]
      _ = (p.coeff n : R) * (c * a ^ n) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = (p.coeff n : R) * (a ^ n * c) := by rw [h_power n]
      _ = (p.coeff n : R) * a ^ n * c := by rw [mul_assoc]
  
  have h_eval :
      c * p.sum (fun n k => (k : R) * a ^ n) =
        p.support.sum (fun n => (p.coeff n : R) * a ^ n * c) := by
    change c * p.support.sum (fun n => (p.coeff n : R) * a ^ n) = _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro n hn
    exact h_coeff n
  
  calc
    (a * x + x * a) * p.sum (fun n k => (k : R) * a ^ n) =
        c * p.sum (fun n k => (k : R) * a ^ n) := by rfl
    _ = p.support.sum (fun n => (p.coeff n : R) * a ^ n * c) := h_eval
    _ = p.sum (fun n k => (k : R) * a ^ n) * c := by
      change _ = p.support.sum (fun n => (p.coeff n : R) * a ^ n) * c
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = p.sum (fun n k => (k : R) * a ^ n) * (a * x + x * a) := by rfl

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem anticommutator_commutes_with_int_polynomial {R : Type*} [Ring R] (a x : R) (h : a ^ 2 = 0) (p : Polynomial ℤ) :
  (a * x + x * a) * p.sum (fun n c => (c : R) * a ^ n) =
    p.sum (fun n c => (c : R) * a ^ n) * (a * x + x * a) := by
  let y : R := a * x + x * a
  
  have hya : y * a = a * y := by
    dsimp [y]
    calc
      (a * x + x * a) * a = a * (x * a) + x * (a ^ 2) := by
        noncomm_ring
      _ = a * (x * a) := by
        rw [h]
        simp
      _ = (a ^ 2) * x + a * (x * a) := by
        rw [h]
        simp
      _ = a * (a * x + x * a) := by
        noncomm_ring
  
  have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, y * a ^ n = a ^ n * y := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        simp
    | succ n ih =>
        simp only [pow_succ]
        calc
          y * (a ^ n * a) = (y * a ^ n) * a := by
            noncomm_ring
          _ = (a ^ n * y) * a := by
            rw [ih]
          _ = a ^ n * (y * a) := by
            noncomm_ring
          _ = a ^ n * (a * y) := by
            rw [hya]
          _ = (a ^ n * a) * y := by
            noncomm_ring
  
  have hterm : ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℤ), y * ((c : R) * a ^ n) =
      ((c : R) * a ^ n) * y := by
    intro n c
    calc
      y * ((c : R) * a ^ n) = (c : R) * (y * a ^ n) := by
        simp only [mul_assoc, Int.cast_comm]
      _ = (c : R) * (a ^ n * y) := by
        rw [hpow n]
      _ = ((c : R) * a ^ n) * y := by
        noncomm_ring
  
  change y * p.sum (fun n c => (c : R) * a ^ n) =
    p.sum (fun n c => (c : R) * a ^ n) * y
  
  rw [Polynomial.sum_def]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n hn => hterm n (p.coeff n))
